transcript: Hiked Mission Peak at sunrise with my dad. Super steep, we stopped like five times. At the top there's that weird metal pole everybody takes photos with. Saw cows grazing on the way down. Dad kept talking about his garden tomatoes. Got pancakes after at a diner with red booths.

spec.moment: Reaching the summit of Mission Peak at sunrise beside the iconic metal pole with dad.

elements.name: weird metal pole
elements.look: a tall weathered metal landmark pole adorned with small metal sights

elements.name: dad
elements.look: a small figure in a tan sun hat and olive green hiking jacket

elements.name: me
elements.look: a small figure in a navy windbreaker leaning on hiking poles

elements.name: grazing cow
elements.look: a small black-and-white spotted cow calmly nibbling grass

elements.name: ripe tomatoes
elements.look: two bright red heirloom garden tomatoes resting on a flat rock

spec.scene: A steep grassy hilltop patch glows in warm apricot dawn light. At the center stands a weathered metal pole on a rocky mound, with two bright red garden tomatoes resting on a boulder at its base. To the right, a father in an olive jacket and tan hat stands beside a hiker in a navy windbreaker holding walking sticks. Along the sloping left edge, a tiny black-and-white cow grazes on dew-touched golden-green grass.
spec.title: Sunrise on Mission Peak
spec.caption: We reached the pole at sunrise, then talked tomatoes all the way down.
